create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms object with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up a SMILES string in the adsorbate database
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by selecting from the database using an integer index
create_adsorbate_random: create an Adsorbate object by randomly sampling from the adsorbate database pickle file
randomly_rotate_adsorbate: randomly rotate an ase.Atoms adsorbate structure using random or heuristic rotation mode
